page: Amazon Web Services r8idn.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and powered by 3.9 GHz Intel x86_64 processors. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The instance includes 256.0 GB of system memory, delivering an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. A bundled local storage capacity of 1900 GB NVMe SSD is integrated directly into the host, accompanied by a 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Discrete GPU accelerators are not present on this instance type.

The inclusion of high-speed local NVMe storage combined with a substantial memory allocation provides high density for workloads with intense local I/O demands. Because local instance storage is ephemeral, architectures requiring persistent retention must incorporate network replication or snapshot routines. The 50 Gbps network interface ensures high data throughput for distributed clusters, though environments that do not require high memory density or local disk caching may experience lower resource efficiency compared to compute-focused tiers.

Given its hardware profile, the r8idn.8xlarge is designed for memory-intensive and I/O-heavy applications. Key workload fits include in-memory databases, distributed memory caches, real-time big data analytics engines, and transactional database servers requiring rapid local scratch space and high network concurrency.
description: Amazon Web Services r8idn.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor and Intel x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores operating at 3.9 GHz, paired with 256.0 GB of RAM to sustain an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance bundles 1900 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a baseline network throughput of 50 Gbps, with zero discrete GPUs included. This combination of dense system memory, dedicated compute capacity, and rapid direct-attached storage eliminates network storage latency for temporary datasets, providing strong resource efficiency for stateful and high-throughput data tasks. However, the ephemeral nature of the local SSD requires external replication strategies for persistent states. The r8idn.8xlarge instance is engineered for demanding workloads such as large in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, distributed caching clusters, and high-performance relational database management systems.
